findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_search, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, enrich_leads, find_contacts, verify_emails · Private data: preview_search, estimate_area_search, search_areas, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, estimate_list, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, enroll_leads, find_contacts · Public sink: get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, find_contacts · Destructive: estimate_area_search, search_areas, find_contacts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_search, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, enrich_leads, find_contacts, verify_emails · Private data: preview_search, estimate_area_search, search_areas, get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, estimate_list, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, enroll_leads, find_contacts · Public sink: get_search_results, search_leads, list_results, get_balance, count_saved_leads, enrich_leads, find_contacts · Destructive: estimate_area_search, search_areas, find_contacts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
